facts.text: Elizabeth City State University participates in the NC Promise program, which reduces undergraduate tuition across several University of North Carolina system institutions.

sources.title: NC Promise - Elizabeth City State University
sources.quote: The NC Promise program helps us do just that. This program dramatically reduces undergraduate tuition rates at several University of North Carolina system institutions, including ECSU.
